events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect post.md tokens, copy rules, pass.py usage and git state
events.input: $ grep -n "PRO_COURSE_NAME\|Tantra Pro [Cc]ourse" workshop-plan/sequences/post.md | head -40; echo ---; git status --short -- workshop-plan/sequences/post.md; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/sequences/post.md; echo ---; grep -n -i "lint\|dash\|banned\|never" workshop-plan/COPY_RULES.md | head -40; ls workshop-plan/*lint* workshop-plan/scripts/*lint* scripts/*lint* 2>/dev/null; echo ---; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py --help 2>&1 | head -30; git status -sb | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read copy rules, check remote, publish hold and spec line
events.input: $ wc -l workshop-plan/COPY_RULES.md workshop-plan/sequences/post.md; cat workshop-plan/COPY_RULES.md; echo; echo ---REMOTE; git remote -v | sed 's#//[^@]*@#//#'; git branch -r --contains 364ef84 | head -3; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; echo ---SPEC; grep -n "Tantra Pro course offer" workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check plan facts in memory and run copy lint greps
events.input: $ M=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory; ls $M | grep -i "plan-lineup"; grep -h -i -n "unlimited\|up to 5\|cohort seat\|Pro Course\|10 \|3 " $M/*plan-lineup* | cut -c1-260 | head -20; echo ---LINT; F=workshop-plan/sequences/post.md; grep -n -P "[\x{2013}\x{2014}]" $F; grep -n -i "calendly\|webinar\|build pass\|live pass\|leverage\|unlock\|end to end\|patchwork\|engineered\|slack" $F; grep -n -E "[0-9]+%|20[0-9]{2}|[0-9]+x\b" $F; grep -n -i "jan\|feb\|march\|april\|june\|july\|aug\|sept\|oct\|nov\|dec\|monday\|tuesday\|wednesday\|thursday\|friday" $
